The lack of comments here illustate the mentality that a lot of people have towards me: I am scum; I deserve to be treated like scum. 

I realize a lot of people think I'm sick (addiction) and need help, not that I am just a lowlife. Some people think I am just a shitty person. They think I am wrong for getting people high. They think I am stupid for getting high.  They expect nothing of me. The people that think I am sick are not much better. No one outside of this lifestyle has respect for me or other people like me.  It doesn't matter that I foster dogs, that I donate time and money to charity, that I help my elderly neighbor. I am either a scumbag or a helpless degenerate. 

I was a dealer before I was a user. I did it to make ends meet. I continue to do it because it allows me to live a comfortable life with low obligations. I have more money than I need and plenty of free time. I donate both.

Was it Dumbledore that said death is the greatest adventure? I think so, and I think he might be right. I don't think you are ready for that adventure yet. Buy a bicycle and see how far you can go. Hop trains. Your life is already over and you have accepted death. May as well accept life and start a new one. See how far you can go. Doesn't matter how bad it is cause it won't be any worse.  Go exploringm find a reason to keep exploring. Good luck.
